source_assets.alpha_scope: Source actor and foreground are opaque; any alpha request rejects before rendering.

contract.publication: Pending source snapshot, protected displayed refs, bank-00 queued HIGH/LOW fences, empty queue before READY, atomic VBlank map commit.

phase_manifest.source_asset_domain: Opaque source-indexed, fixed camera, immutable component palette; NOT dynamic SCREEN alpha

contract.temporary_bitmap_lifetime: Before restoration records exist, during conservative prediction only.

right.services: Legacy NMI/audio/video service is withdrawn by the retained isolated source fixture. Minimal owned NMI services only $4210; NMI disabled during native preparation/preload/commit, auto-JOY restored when idle. No audio timing claim.
right.source_movement: Actual JOY1 RIGHT, X 81 -> 81.5 through retained input-history, ground/frame, velocity and check_move pipeline

integration_changes: Added whitespace between Lua callback body and closing end; returned JSON-native record lists to preserve exact RIGHT trace equality after serialization. Added Lua separator assertions and a JSON round-trip regression test. Supplied planner and VM unchanged.
handoff.excluded_trial: v1 stopped before cold publication due to Lua syntax error; log retained; not counted as native PASS evidence.
